★
Achievement unlockedStar-Lord's Walkman

Every playable scenario now has its own music. Kingpin, all three Shadowland scenarios, Breakout, Kang, Absorbing Man, Zola, and Captain Marvel, She-Hulk and Vision from Civil War get their own battle, victory and defeat songs, Fear No Evil and Shadowland get an interlude and a finale, and Stop the Presses! and Crossbones get new takes. The desktop game now updates itself from any installer and can add itself to Steam, and shared replays open on a versus screen. Discord shows your mod's villain and hero instead of only the logo, and the Title counts the mods that have an update.

PRs #848, #849, #852 and #854

Where you'll hear them

  • Battle tracks play during the scenario, and open in the jukebox once you've played it.
  • Victory and defeat tracks play on the Game Over screen, and open when you win or lose there.
  • Interludes play between a campaign's scenarios, and finales once you've won the campaign.

Updates that install themselves

Issues #843, #844 · PRs #847, #850
★
Achievement unlockedQuicksilver Delivery

The desktop game now updates itself, whichever installer you used. When a new release is out, the Title's update banner offers Update. The game downloads it in the background while you keep playing, tells you when it's ready, and Restart puts you on the new version.

Heads up: Update shows when a release newer than yours is out. v0.50.0 itself is still a download from the website, and the release after it is the first one the game installs for you.

Each installer, its own way

  • Windows: the Setup .exe installs quietly and starts the game again. The .msi asks for an administrator's permission first.
  • Mac: the new app is swapped in for the old one in a single step, on disks that allow it (APFS).
  • Linux: the AppImage is replaced where you keep it. A .deb or .rpm asks for an administrator's password.
  • Every download is checked against the checksum GitHub lists before the game closes. If the install fails, your old game starts again and the Title says so.
  • Android and Steam script installs update the way they did before.

Add to Steam

Settings ▸ More ▸ Add to Steam puts the game you have in your Steam library with its art, to play from Steam and Big Picture. It runs the Install for Steam script in the background, without downloading anything.

Steam is closed while its library is updated, and the panel tells you first. The row only shows when Steam is installed and the game isn't in it yet, and on Linux it's for the AppImage. After that, updates go through the Steam script.

Replays that enter like a boss fight

Issue #858 · PR #859
★
Achievement unlockedThe Watcher Is Watching

A shared replay link no longer lands on the title menu first. It opens on its own loading screen, then a versus screen of the villain against the heroes slides in with a whoosh, and the board comes up underneath. Every replay opens this way now, from Past games, Game over and the Title too.

Also with replays

  • An expired, invalid or unreachable link says why on the loading screen, with a Main menu button.
  • Opening a replay file lives in Past games, with a folder icon. In the desktop app it opens your system's own Open dialog, so a controller's A press works on Steam Deck and Bazzite.
  • A replay plays its scenario's battle music.
  • Settings opened from Pause no longer draws over the sheets it opens, such as Controls.

Your mods, on Discord and the Title

Issues #840, #845 · PRs #841, #855
★
Achievement unlockedGwenpool Breaks the Fourth Wall

With Discord open, the desktop app shows your game on your Discord profile. An official game shows the villain's card as the big picture and your hero in the corner, but a game with mod content showed only the game's logo. Now a pack installed from the Mod Store shows its own villain and hero, the same way.

How it works

  • The pictures come from the Mod Store's public copy of the pack you have installed, in English or the pack's own language.
  • A pack you added from a file, a version the store doesn't list, or a pack taken off the store keeps the logo, as before.
  • The Get the game button on your profile now opens the downloads on champions-digital-game.com instead of the GitHub release page. Discord shows it on your full profile, not the small popout.

Updates for your mods

When a pack you installed has a newer version in the Mod Store, the Title's Mod Store button and its storefront icon show a red badge with how many packs have an update. Update them in the store and the badge clears.

Issue #845 · PR #855

You asked, we fixed

Issue #856 by @Merman-Helville · PR #857
★
Achievement unlockedSweet Christmas!

Power Man's chi counters are a question you can answer. His Action asks how many chi counters to discard. The bar read "How many chi?" with a red 2 on a red bar, so it looked like a caption, not a choice. Now it asks Remove how many chi counters?, every count is a paper button you can see, and every "up to N counters" cost asks the same way.
